test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘ASIA’ is written as ‘ZHRZ’ and ‘IRELAND’ is written as ‘RIVOZMW’. How will ‘NORWAY’ be written in that language?
solution: The Position and Positional values of English Alphabets are: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] The logic followed here is:** Each letter of a word is coded with their opposite letter in English Alphabet series.** For, ‘ASIA’ is written as ‘ZHRZ’
